title: Eugenicist elites become the Nordics
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Eugenicist elites become the Nordics, about 1890s-1930s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and that's that these elites become the Nordics

plain: A writer named Jason Jorjani argues that the elites who backed eugenics, the idea of improving humans through controlled breeding, in the US, Britain and Germany from the 1890s to the 1930s, later turn up as the "Nordics", tall, fair, human-looking beings described in UFO reports. He names the birth control campaigner Margaret Sanger among them and draws on a book called Closer Encounters, suggesting that some alien sightings may tie back to these human groups.
